==Description==
[[File:Fruits_of_Heptapleurum_venulosum.jpg|thumb|left|fruits]]
A large climbing shrub, leaves elliptic-lanceolate, cuneate, coriaceous main veins distinct. Umbels on racemes; peduncles long; pedicels of umbels 2 – 3 cm long, Flowers pentamerous, pedicellad, Petals greenish-white. Ovary 5-locular; styles short, free. Drupes subglobose, brownish-black. Flowering - February till March.<ref>{{cite book|title=The trees, shrubs, and woody-climbers of the Bombay Presidency|author=Talbot, W.A.|page=181|url=https://archive.org/details/treesshrubswoody1902talb/page/180/mode/1up|year=1902|publisher=Government Central Press|place=Bombay}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|page=369|url=https://archive.org/details/forestfloraofch00hain/page/369/mode/1up|title=A forest flora of Chota Nagpur including Gangpur and the Santal-Parganahs|author=Haines, H. H. |year=1910|place=Dehra Dun }}</ref>  

==Range==
The native range of this species is Indian Subcontinent.<ref name="a571"/> [[Bangladesh]],<ref name="a571"/><ref name="w689"/> [[India]],<ref name="a571"/><ref name="w689"/> [[Nepal]],<ref name="a571"/> [[China]],<ref name="w689"/> [[Malaysia]],<ref name="w689"/> and [[Myanmar]].<ref name="w689">{{cite journal | last1=Foundation) | first1=Development) | last2=Upadhaya | first2=Krishna | title=The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species | journal=IUCN Red List of Threatened Species | date=2021-04-26 | url=https://www.iucnredlist.org/species/176857635/176861780 | access-date=2026-04-15 | page=}}</ref>.
Within India distribution is in the states of [[Andhra Pradesh]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Karnataka]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Kerala]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Jharkhand]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Uttarakhand]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Himachal Pradesh]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Uttar Pradesh]],<ref name="l081"/> [[Punjab]],<ref name="l081"/> and [[Andaman and Nicobar Islands]].<ref name="l081">{{cite web | title=India Flora Online | website=India Flora Online | date=2026-04-15 | url=https://indiaflora-ces.iisc.ac.in/herbsheet.php?id=10555&cat=13 | access-date=2026-04-15}}</ref>

==Habitat==
It is a scrambling tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.<ref name="a571"/>
